name: tle-fetcher
description: Terminal utility to retrieve TLE data from the TLE API using NORAD catalog ID

paragraphs: This repository contains a robust terminal-based utility for fetching up-to-date Two-Line Element (TLE) data for satellites from publicly available sources. It supports multiple data providers—CelesTrak and Ivan's TLE API by default, with optional fallback to Space-Track and N2YO when credentials are provided. The tool can fetch single IDs interactively or process a batch of IDs from a queue file, validating and caching results.
features: Retro synthwave control panel UI with analog gauges and LED indicators
Real-time pass computation using SGP4 propagation (satellite.js)
Local TLE assets with automatic CelesTrak fallback
Satellite metadata from SatNOGS DB and CelesTrak SATCAT
Fully static - runs on GitHub Pages without a server
